options.content: 📊 This dashboard reads the Flink **pre-aggregated** `user_key_aggregates` table in the `userkeys` database, which holds one row per closed tumbling window per (user_id, key) — so these queries stay cheap as the pipeline scales. For live (15s) pipeline metrics, use the **userKeys Pipeline Health** dashboard, which queries Prometheus.

panels.title: Latest window sums per (user, key)
panels.description: The most recent window's value_sum for each (user_id, key), newest windows first. One row per distinct (user_id, key) seen in range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id, key)
       window_start,
       window_end,
       user_id,
       key,
       value_sum::bigint AS value_sum
FROM user_key_aggregates
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)
ORDER BY user_id, key, window_start DESC;

panels.title: value_sum per window by (user, key)
panels.description: Time series of value_sum keyed at window_start, one line per (user_id, key). Tracks how each key's per-window summed value evolves over time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT window_start AS time,
       value_sum::bigint AS value,
       user_id || ' / ' || key AS metric
FROM user_key_aggregates
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)
ORDER BY window_start;
